title: Emotion Is Not External Knowledge: Internal Attention Signals for Affective State Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.21347v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly operate in multi-turn interactions that require maintaining latent conversational states, not only explicit facts. We study affective state as an implicit state inferred from sparse contextual cues that remain relevant after topic shifts, and ask whether LLMs expose internal attention signals for routing such evidence at inference time. Prior attention interventions rely on labeled in-domain head profiles and externally specified target spans, limiting transfer across affective-evidence distributions. We propose Self-targeted Internal Attention Boosting (SIAB), which localizes sparse affective heads via causal localization (in detail activation patching) on synthetic minimal pairs and boosts, at the answer position, the content tokens these heads already attend to; both edited heads and target tokens are derived from the model's own behavior, enabling the same head set to be reused across tasks.W

translated_title: 情绪并非外部知识：用于情感状态推理的内部注意力信号
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地运行在需要维持潜在对话状态的多轮交互中，而不仅仅是处理显式事实。我们研究情感状态作为一种隐式状态——它是由稀疏的上下文线索推断出来的，且这些线索在话题转移后依然保持相关性——并探讨LLM是否在推理时暴露出用于路由此类证据的内部注意力信号。先前的注意力干预方法依赖于带标注的域内注意力头画像和外部指定的目标片段，这限制了其在不同情感证据分布之间的迁移能力。我们提出了自定向内部注意力增强方法，该方法通过因果定位（具体为激活修补）在合成最小对比样本上定位稀疏的情感注意力头，并在答案位置增强这些注意力头本身所关注的内容词元；被编辑的注意力头和目标词元均源自模型自身的行为，从而使相同的注意力头集合能够在不同任务之间复用。
tldr: 该论文提出SIAB方法，通过激活修补在合成样本上定位模型内部的稀疏情感注意力头，并在推理时增强这些注意力头自身关注的内容词元，从而实现无需外部标注、可跨任务复用的情感状态推理。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes SIAB, which localizes sparse affective attention heads via activation patching on synthetic minimal pairs and boosts the content tokens these heads already attend to at inference time, enabling label-free and transferable affective state reasoning across tasks.
